# Analysis

```{r}
nums <- c(12, 15, 18, 20, 21, 23, 25, 26)
count <- length(nums)
average <- mean(nums)
print(length(nums))
offsets <- nums - average
powers <- offsets ^ 2
total <- sum(powers)
spread <- total / (count - 1)
scale <- sqrt(spread)
uncertainty <- scale / sqrt(count)
displayed <- round(average, 2)
print(displayed)
print(uncertainty)
```
